newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,401 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,401 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,401 contracts compared with 352 overnight Thursday.
There were 120 wheat, 520 corn, 496 soybean, 85 soymeal, seven soyoil, 26 oat, two rice, two wheat call, 12 corn call, 124 corn put and seven soybean calls traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1-1/4 to 2-1/2 cents lower, corn was two to 2-1/4 cents lower and soybeans were three to 7-1/2 cents lower.
